title: SR AutoSort
description: Take inventory organization to the next level with automated sorting and personalized player settings.
body:

SR_AutoSort is a versatile and lightweight utility designed to eliminate the mess in your inventories and storage units. Developed by me.swordred, this plugin provides a universal sorting solution that works across your personal inventory and all types of storage containers. Whether you are a hoarder or a meticulous organizer, SR_AutoSort ensures your items are always in the right place with minimal effort.  
Key Features
Universal Storage Support: Works perfectly with all types of Chests, Trapped Chests, and Barrels.  
Dual-Mode Sorting: Supports sorting for both the player's personal inventory and external storage containers.  
Double-Click to Sort: Features an intuitive "Double-Click" gesture to instantly organize items within any supported container.  
Personalized Player Settings: Use /sort to access individual settings, allowing players to toggle sorting on or off for specific targets.  
Smart Interaction: The AutoSortListener detects your actions in real-time to provide instant organization without lag.  
How to Use
Toggle Settings: Use the /sort command to customize your sorting preferences.  
Instant Organize: Simply Double-Click inside any chest, barrel, or your inventory to trigger the auto-sort function.  
Automatic Handling: Once enabled, the plugin will maintain your designated SortMode across all supported storage types.
